### Bible Pathway - August 24
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-aug-24-2013.html
Passage: Jeremiah 35:5-6
Points:
- Beyond the topic of alcohol, this account illustrates holding firmly to core convictions.
- The Rechabites modeled steadfast faithfulness through obedience to their forefather's command.
- Christians must use the Word of God as an uncompromising standard for daily living.
- Trials test genuine faith, revealing whether believers compromise under pressure or stand for truth.
